accessStyle.description: Which access style to use. Defaults to virtual hosted-style as most of the data products out there. Have a look at the official documentation on <https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/VirtualHosting.html>

credentials.description: If the S3 uses authentication you have to specify you S3 credentials. In the most cases a SecretClass providing `accessKey` and `secretKey` is sufficient.

host.description: Hostname of the S3 server without any protocol or port

port.description: Port the S3 server listens on. If not specified the products will determine the port to use.

tls.description: If you want to use TLS when talking to S3 you can enable TLS encrypted communication with this setting.
